name: kopi-pos
description: Coffee Shop POS — multi-branch ready point of sale, inventory and analytics platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @kopi-pos/api" "npm run dev -w @kopi-pos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kopi-pos/api && npm run build -w @kopi-pos/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @kopi-pos/api" "npm run start -w @kopi-pos/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kopi-pos/api && npm run typecheck -w @kopi-pos/web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @kopi-pos/web && cap sync android
